01 BOTTOM LINE

SOURCE OPINION TrendForce estimates the combined Marvell-Lumentum entity would hold nearly 7% of the semiconductor wired communications market, ranking behind only NVIDIA and Broadcom, combining Marvell's electronic/DSP strengths with Lumentum's InP laser and optical components. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩ C-3a1ec34707ef65 C-96e82df12b1321
SOURCE OPINION TrendForce frames the deal as reshaping the optical communications competitive landscape, giving NVIDIA and CSPs broader electro-optical sourcing options and potentially reducing reliance on Broadcom. C-9ac7cd6b683cb2 C-96e82df12b1321 C-61a51ee3a9bb6e
MODEL INFERENCE If completed, the merger would create a more integrated electro-optical competitor that could take share from Broadcom in AI optical interconnects as the industry moves to CPO/NPO; the article does not quantify revenue, earnings or valuation effects for any issuer.
